Message:
fbdev: change asm/uaccess.h to linux/uaccess.h

This patch replaces <asm/uaccess.h> with <linux/uaccess.h> after the
checkpatch.pl hint.  The include of <asm/uaccess.h> is removed if the driver
does not use it.
